name: MonarchAiPlan
title: AiPlan
wrapsNative: MonarchCard with a VStack of rows (MonarchDragHandle with draggable(_:) and dropDestination(for:action:isTargeted:), MonarchInlineEditText, an icon Button) and MonarchButton for Add, Reject and Approve; MonarchAiChainOfSteps once decided
summary: The plan an agent proposes before it acts, which a person edits, reorders, approves or rejects, and which then shows the steps as the agent works through them.
whenToUse: When an agent should not act until a person agrees: show the plan part (MonarchAiPlanPart) from the message model and run the approved steps.
whenNotToUse: Not to show steps the agent is already running with no approval (use MonarchAiChainOfSteps) and not for a single risky tool call (use MonarchAiToolResultCard or a confirmation dialog).
api: init(_ part: MonarchAiPlanPart, decision: MonarchAiPlanDecision? = nil, isEditable: Bool = true, labels: MonarchAiPlanLabels = MonarchAiPlanLabels(), onChange: (@MainActor ([MonarchAiPlanStep]) -> Void)? = nil, onReject: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onApprove: (@MainActor ([MonarchAiPlanStep]) -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchAiPlanDecision { case pending, approved, rejected }

struct MonarchAiPlanLabels { init(title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, editHint: String? = nil, approvedNotice: String? = nil, rejectedNotice: String? = nil, stepLabel: ((Int) -> String)? = nil, stepPlaceholder: String? = nil, untitledStep: ((Int) -> String)? = nil, reorder: ((String) -> String)? = nil, moved: ((String, Int, Int) -> String)? = nil, remove: ((String) -> String)? = nil, removed: ((String) -> String)? = nil, addStep: String? = nil, approve: String? = nil, reject: String? = nil, emptyPlan: String? = nil) }

options.name: part
options.description: The plan part the agent proposed. Its steps seed the draft; a new part from the model (not an echo of the draft) replaces it.

options.name: decision
options.description: The decision, when the app owns it. When nil the view keeps its own after Approve or Reject.

options.name: isEditable
options.description: Whether the person can change the steps before deciding. Once decided the plan is always read-only.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the title.

options.name: onChange
options.description: Called with the draft after every edit, move, addition and removal.

options.name: onReject
options.description: Called when the person rejects the plan.

options.name: onApprove
options.description: Called with the approved steps, labels trimmed and empty steps left out.

states.name: pending, editable
states.description: Each step is a numbered row with a drag handle, the step text as an inline editor and a remove button; Add step, Reject and Approve plan follow.

states.name: pending, read-only
states.description: isEditable false: the steps as a MonarchAiChainOfSteps with Reject and Approve plan.

states.name: empty
states.description: Every step empty: Approve plan is disabled and a note says to add a step.

states.name: approved
states.description: The description reads the approved notice; the cleaned steps show as a MonarchAiChainOfSteps whose states follow the part and are announced.

states.name: rejected
states.description: The description reads the rejected notice; the steps show read-only with no buttons.

states.name: drop target
states.description: While a dragged step is over a row, the row takes the AI subtle background.

appearance: A Monarch card: the title in the subheading style and default text role, the description and step numbers in the muted text role, a drop target in the AI subtle role. Buttons are Monarch ghost, secondary and primary buttons. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Planned as a List with onMove; built as a VStack instead, because the plan sits inside a scrolling conversation where a List cannot size itself, and onMove only works inside a List. Steps move by dragging the handle onto another step, or with the handle's Move up and Move down actions; the web also shows visible move buttons and keyboard reordering. The web's text inputs are always open with Enter adding a step and Backspace removing an empty one; iOS uses MonarchInlineEditText, which opens on tap and saves on Return or when focus leaves. The web's title prop is labels.title. The web announces through a live region; iOS posts accessibility announcements.
accessibility: The plan is a container named by its title; the title has the header trait.
Each step's text is a button named "Step 2" whose value is the step text, with the Edit hint of MonarchInlineEditText.
Each drag handle is named "Reorder <step>" and offers Move up and Move down actions; a move is announced as "<step>, position 2 of 3".
Each remove button is named "Remove <step>"; a removal is announced as "Removed <step>".
An empty step is named "step 2" in these names.
Approving or rejecting announces the approved or rejected notice; once approved the chain of steps announces starts and failures.
The step number is hidden from VoiceOver because the step label carries it.
Every control has a 44-point touch target; the footer buttons stack when they do not fit.
edgeCases: A step whose text is only spaces counts as empty and is left out of the approved steps.
A new step opens its editor at once.
When the app passes a decision and neither onApprove nor onReject, no buttons are shown.
Long steps wrap at every text size.

examples.title: Editable proposal
An approved plan, running
examples.code:
MonarchAiPlan(
    MonarchAiPlanPart(steps: [
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "find", label: "Find the three open invoices", state: .done),
        MonarchAiPlanStep(id: "send", label: "Send the reminders", state: .active),
    ]),
    decision: .approved
)
